layers.text: Recolour as a peppermint chocolate and change no shape: the pink top of the round sweet becomes a pale mint green #a8e6cf and white swirl; its sides and base become dark chocolate #4a2412 with a lighter #7a4526 shine; the fuse and the white spark stay. No pink is left. Keep every shape, thick black outline and style the same, on a transparent background.
